analysisMethod: Linux CNA programFiles for every listed CVE are kernel implementation or private headers, not exported UAPI; none is shipped in the exact official package. Canonical explicit binary-exclude tags are retained per entry without extrapolating them to other CVEs. CI must match all installed owned-file hashes and reject ELF/kernel payloads and any runtime package before using this classification. Host kernel applicability is outside scope.
